description: This Java source file implements the ProductOptionDao interface, providing data access methods for ProductOption entities, including listing, retrieving by ID, searching by name, handling read-only options, saving or updating entities, and retrieving by code, within the context of a specific merchant store and language.

classes.name: ProductOptionDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ProductOptionDao interface, providing database operations for ProductOption entities using QueryDSL with JPA.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOption entities associated with a specific merchant store and language, including descriptions and store info.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a ProductOption by its ID, including related descriptions and store data.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves ProductOptions matching a name pattern for a specific store and language.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves all read-only ProductOptions for a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new ProductOption entity or updates an existing one, handling persistence.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a ProductOption by its unique code within a store.
